The pipe-supporting towers and pipes shall be erected over civil foundations constructed at defined locations avoiding interference with the existing on/overground operating facilities. Piping erection shall be done sequentially so that all pipes get a crane approach during erection. Fabricated pieces of pipes shall be transported from the fabrication yard to the erection place and assembled in erectable length at the ground below the site where the same will be erected. Erection of towers and pipes may be done with the help of a 50 metric tonne (MT) mobile crane with a telescopic boom. 2.3.2 CO Capture Unit 2 This part covers the construction of various structural sheds for the installation of Process Equipment, heat exchangers, pumps, CO Compressors, Dehydration System Equipment, and CO Pump House Equipment. 2 2 Apart from this, multiple vessels like Absorber Contactor Vessel, Stripper Contactor Vessel, Absorber Cooler Vessel, UWW Surge Vessel, and a few tanks like Solvent Maintenance Tank, Solvent Washdown Tank. The segments of these vessels and tanks shall be assembled at the site to form a ring-shaped part and shall be erected one above the other with the help of a mobile crane. While the structural sheds and lower portion of tanks and vessels can be erected with a 150 MT capacity crane, the higher part of the Absorber Contactor Vessel shall be erected with the help of a 500 MT capacity mobile crane with a fly-jib arrangement. The equipment inside Sheds may be erected with the help of an EOT crane within the shed. The above methodology shall be further detailed once more information is available at the detailed engineering phase. 2.3.3 Auxiliary Units This part covers the construction of structural units and installation of various plants and equipment in BF gas compressors, BF gas preheater, Water Gas Shift reactors, BFW preheater, WGS boilers, quench tower, the DM plant, and Combined Heat and Power Plants. The structures and equipment may be assembled at the site assembly area and erected with the help of a suitable mobile crane. 2.4 Health Study of Existing Building It is envisaged that a part of the supply and return gas piping shall be supported through a bracket Attachment-6: Constructability Review 8 DE-FE0031937 / 0007 arrangement taking support from the existing shop building column. Since BF gas piping is a heavy steel structure connected to the building in a cantilever, a heavy load will be transferred to the existing columns of the building. As such, to assess the condition of the columns of the existing building and to suggest a suitable strengthening measure, a health study of the existing columns needs to be carried out. A health study is required to understand the present condition of the steel columns and the civil foundations and the strengthening measure needed to be taken up. 2.5 Enabling Works The following enabling works before the start of actual construction need to be taken up: 2.5.1 Geotechnical investigation works: This work is to be taken up
